OTTO_XUAN_DOG.title: Xuan Dog
OTTO_XUAN_DOG.description: Zoo companion. At the end of your turn, gain 4 Block and deal 4 damage to a random enemy.
OTTO_SHAN_NI_RUO.title: Shan Ni Ruo
OTTO_SHAN_NI_RUO.description: Zoo companion. At the end of your turn, heal 2 HP.
OTTO_HUO_XING_BAO.title: Huo Xing Bao
OTTO_HUO_XING_BAO.description: Zoo companion. At the end of your turn, gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity.
OTTO_ICE_POWER.title: Ice
OTTO_ICE_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Amount} Block. If Shan Ni Ruo is present, heal that much HP.
OTTO_PRO_PLAYER_POWER.title: Pro Player
OTTO_PRO_PLAYER_POWER.description: Whenever you play a card, gain {Amount} Pix.
OTTO_PIX.title: Pix
OTTO_PIX.description: At the end of combat, gain {Amount} Max HP and heal that much HP.
OTTO_CARD_RULES.title: Card Records
OTTO_CARD_RULES.description: Tracks Cans played this combat and Hands played this turn.
OTTO_FREE_CAN.title: Next Can Free
OTTO_FREE_CAN.description: The next Can you play this combat costs 0 Energy.
OTTO_NO_ATTACK_NEXT_TURN.title: Suona Aftermath
OTTO_NO_ATTACK_NEXT_TURN.description: You cannot play Attacks on your next turn. Expires at the end of that turn.
OTTO_NO_MORE_CARDS.title: Silver Moment
OTTO_NO_MORE_CARDS.description: You cannot play any more cards this turn.
OTTO_FLAT_GUARD.title: Void Protection
OTTO_FLAT_GUARD.description: Reduce each instance of damage taken by {Amount}, to a minimum of 0. Expires at the start of your next turn.
OTTO_ZOO_BOND.title: Zoo Bond
OTTO_ZOO_BOND.description: Different Zoo companions coexist, at most one of each.
OTTO_DOG_TRAINING.title: Trained Xuan Dog
OTTO_DOG_TRAINING.description: Xuan Dog deals 10 damage and grants 10 Block at turn end. Persists through replacement. Does not stack.
OTTO_MARS_TRAINING.title: Trained Huo Xing Bao
OTTO_MARS_TRAINING.description: Huo Xing Bao grants 3 Strength and 3 Dexterity at turn end. Persists through replacement. Does not stack.
OTTO_PIG_TRAINING.title: Trained Shan Ni Ruo
OTTO_PIG_TRAINING.description: Shan Ni Ruo heals 4 HP and applies 4 Poison to all enemies at turn end. Persists through replacement. Does not stack.
OTTO_XUAN_DOG.trainedDescription: Trained Zoo companion. At turn end, gain 10 Block and deal 10 damage to a random enemy.
OTTO_SHAN_NI_RUO.trainedDescription: Trained Zoo companion. At turn end, heal 4 HP and apply 4 Poison to all enemies.
OTTO_HUO_XING_BAO.trainedDescription: Trained Zoo companion. At turn end, gain 3 Strength and 3 Dexterity.
OTTO_NO_ATTACK_NEXT_TURN.activeDescripti: You cannot play Attacks this turn. Expires at turn end.
OTTO_NO_ATTACK_NEXT_TURN.activeAndPendin: You cannot play Attacks this turn or your next turn.
OTTO_ANCIENT_METER.title: Ancient Charge
OTTO_ANCIENT_METER.description: Transform at {Threshold} Meter and clear it. No Meter is gained in the form.
OTTO_ANCIENT_FORM.title: Ancient Form
OTTO_ANCIENT_FORM.description:
Immune to damage; deal double damage. Direct kills still apply.
Ends after {Amount} more starts of your turn.
OTTO_DOG_BOOST.title: Dog Boost
OTTO_DOG_BOOST.description: Xuan Dog gains {Amount} additional damage and Block each turn this combat. Adds to training; persists while absent or imprisoned.
OTTO_PIG_BOOST.title: Pig Boost
OTTO_PIG_BOOST.description: Shan Ni Ruo heals {Amount} additional HP each turn this combat. Adds to training; persists while absent or imprisoned.
OTTO_MARS_BOOST.title: Mars Boost
OTTO_MARS_BOOST.description: Huo Xing Bao grants {Amount} additional Strength and Dexterity each turn this combat. Adds to training; persists while absent or imprisoned.
OTTO_DOG_PRISON.title: Xuan Dog: Prison
OTTO_DOG_PRISON.description: Xuan Dog is absent. Normal summons and Zoo Bond cannot release him. Only Your Youth, Revived releases prisoners.
OTTO_PIG_PRISON.title: Shan Ni Ruo: Prison
OTTO_PIG_PRISON.description: Shan Ni Ruo is absent. Normal summons and Zoo Bond cannot release him. Only Your Youth, Revived releases prisoners.
OTTO_MARS_PRISON.title: Huo Xing Bao: Prison
OTTO_MARS_PRISON.description: Huo Xing Bao is absent. Normal summons and Zoo Bond cannot release him. Only Your Youth, Revived releases prisoners.
OTTO_PIG_GUARD.title: Teng Yang Guard
OTTO_PIG_GUARD.description: While Shan Ni Ruo is present, block every hit of the next enemy attack that hits you, then imprison him. Attacks only hitting allies do not consume this.
OTTO_WHY_POWER.title: Why?
OTTO_WHY_POWER.description: Draw {Amount} extra cards each turn. Combat cards cost a random 0–3, rerolled on each draw for this combat. X-cost and unplayable cards are unchanged. Enemy intents are hidden.
OTTO_HOU_GUOYU.title: Hou Guoyu
OTTO_HOU_GUOYU.description: You can lose {Remaining} more HP this round. Resets to 10 at the start of your turn. Does not prevent direct kills.
OTTO_KING_STUN.title: King Stun
OTTO_KING_STUN.description: Stunned for the next {Amount} actions. Then resume the interrupted move.
OTTO_XUAN_DOG.scalingDescription: At the end of your turn, gain {Value} Block and deal {Value} damage to a random enemy (Ancient Form still modifies damage).
OTTO_SHAN_NI_RUO.scalingDescription: At the end of your turn, heal {Value} HP.
OTTO_SHAN_NI_RUO.scalingTrainedDescripti: At the end of your turn, heal {Value} HP and apply 4 Poison to ALL enemies.
OTTO_HUO_XING_BAO.scalingDescription: At the end of your turn, gain {Value} Strength and {Value} Dexterity.
OTTO_FIRST_CAN_ENERGY.title: Toyokawa Sakiko
OTTO_FIRST_CAN_ENERGY.description: Each turn, gain {Amount} Energy on your first manual Can play (any hand position). Stacking does not refresh the trigger.
OTTO_ANCIENT_THRESHOLD.title: Next Ancient Threshold
OTTO_ANCIENT_THRESHOLD.description: The next transformation requires {Amount} Meter. Each new transformation raises the threshold by 25.
OTTO_LAW_ABIDING_POWER.title: Law Abiding
OTTO_LAW_ABIDING_POWER.description: Prevent Shan Ni Ruo's first imprisonment this combat and have it act 3 times.
OTTO_KFC_POWER.title: KFC
OTTO_KFC_POWER.description: Until your next turn, Shan Ni Ruo replaces healing with damage to ALL enemies equal to {Amount} times its normal healing.
OTTO_MARS_MODE.title: Huo Xing Bao Mode
OTTO_MARS_MODE.description: Strength Mode: actions grant double normal Strength and no Dexterity.
OTTO_DOG_COUNTER.title: Great Blade Counter
OTTO_DOG_COUNTER.description: Until your next turn, while Xuan Dog is present, each enemy attack hit fully blocked by spending Block triggers a counter for 3 times its damage.
OTTO_LAST_XUAN.title: Endless Youth
OTTO_LAST_XUAN.description: On lethal damage, imprison Xuan Dog if present and restore to 50% Max HP, rounded up. Does not prevent direct kills.
OTTO_LOST_PARADISE.title: Lost Paradise
OTTO_LOST_PARADISE.description: After each Attack is played, Huo Xing Bao acts immediately if present.
OTTO_LAUGHTER.title: OTTO Laughter
OTTO_LAUGHTER.description: When you trigger Can, play that card one additional time for free.
OTTO_DA_SI_MA.title: Wuhu Da Si Ma
OTTO_DA_SI_MA.description: Record the last manually played non-X Attack or Skill each turn; play an extra copy for free after drawing next turn.
OTTO_V5_POWER.title: v5-otto
OTTO_V5_POWER.description: At the end of your turn, directly play {Amount} random cards with Block effects from all character pools for free; {Upgraded} are Upgraded.
OTTO_AMINOS_POWER.title: Aminos
OTTO_AMINOS_POWER.description: Ancient Form lasts {Amount} additional rounds this combat.
OTTO_SUONA_POWER.title: Suona
OTTO_SUONA_POWER.description: Each turn, play your third manually played card one additional time. Auto-plays do not count.
OTTO_NANAMI_POWER.title: Nanami
OTTO_NANAMI_POWER.description: The Ancient Form threshold is fixed at 100 this combat.
OTTO_LAW_ABIDING_POWER.usedDescription: Imprisonment protection has been used this combat. Playing this again does not reset it.
OTTO_MARS_MODE.dexterityDescription: Dexterity Mode: actions grant double normal Dexterity and no Strength.
OTTO_HUO_XING_BAO.strengthDescription: At the end of your turn, gain {Value} Strength and no Dexterity.
OTTO_HUO_XING_BAO.dexterityDescription: At the end of your turn, gain {Value} Dexterity and no Strength.
OTTO_ANCIENT_METER.rulesDescription: Transform at 100 Meter; each new transformation raises the threshold by 25. Transforming clears Meter; none is gained in the form.
OTTO_ANCIENT_METER.cardRulesDescription:
Transform at 100 Meter; each new transformation raises the threshold by 25. Transforming clears Meter; none is gained in the form.
Ancient Form: immune to damage, double damage until your next turn. Direct kills still apply.
OTTO_ZOO_SUMMARY.title: Zoo Companions
OTTO_ZOO_SUMMARY.description:
At your turn end: Xuan Dog deals 4 damage and grants 4 Block; Shan Ni Ruo heals 2 HP; Huo Xing Bao grants 1 Strength and Dexterity.
Training and modes change their actions. Ordinary summons cannot free imprisoned companions.
OTTO_ANCIENT_CARD.title: Ancient Cards
OTTO_ANCIENT_CARD.description: Cards that gain Ancient Meter, enter Ancient Form, or have form-specific effects.
